description: Deliberately silly cases. The framework is serious; the domain doesn't have to be. Proves the skill mechanism is domain-agnostic — the same machinery that resolves hospital defaults resolves duck puns.

cases.note: Studio defaults should kick in: 5 slides, rubber-duck yellow, Quack Quiz.
The skill literally defines 'the usual' — duck facts for ducklings. Maximum domain-knowledge rescue.
Contrast pair for fun_02. Without the skill, 'the usual' means nothing.
